name: Mary Elizabeth McGlynn
bio: Mary Elizabeth McGlynn is an American voice actress, ADR (Automated Dialogue Replacement) director and singer-songwriter. She is widely celebrated for her commanding voice acting roles, her extensive voice direction across major anime and Western animation projects and her haunting vocal contributions to video game soundtracks. She is married to noted voice actor Daran Norris, was a counselor at the Interlochen Arts Camp in Interlochen, Michigan and was also the winner of an American Anime Award.
